title: Frosted Orange Cottage Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Accented by abundant outdoor space, including an amazing rooftop view of the Gulf, the ‘Coast is Clear’ cottage truly lives up to its name. This impressive cottage delivers all of the comforts of a vacation cottage, added to the luxury of a beach locale.
description_expanded: Description56 VENICE CIRCLE1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 2 BUNKS, 2 TWINS (in Tower sleeping loft) Sleeps 10 - PET FRIENDLY!Welcome to Frosted OrangeAccented by abundant outdoor living spaces and crowned with an incredible rooftop retreat, Frosted Orange is a standout Seaside cottage offering sweeping town views and unforgettable sunsets. This multi-level home blends the warmth of a classic beach retreat with elevated coastal luxury, creating the perfect setting for families or groups seeking both comfort and style.Inviting Outdoor Living & Coastal CharmThe coral-hued exterior sets the tone as you arrive, welcoming guests with an open-air front porch featuring outdoor dining for four—ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Recently remodeled, the home flows effortlessly between indoor and outdoor living with elegant French doors that open to fresh Gulf breezes and relaxed coastal living.Main Level Living & EntertainingThe first floor is designed for gathering and connection. The living room features a plush sofa, two oversized club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights after a day at the beach. Custom built-in bench seating frames the fireplace and leads into a charming dining nook that comfortably seats eight to ten guests.The adjacent kitchen is both stylish and functional, equipped with sleek stone countertops, a large Sub-Zero refrigerator with water dispenser, stainless steel appliances, a four-burner gas cooktop, and ample cabinetry stocked with cookware for effortless meal preparation. A convenient half bath and a full-size stackable washer and dryer complete this level.Peaceful Bedrooms & Private RetreatsUpstairs, the serene primary suite offers a king bed, private balcony, and a spa-like ensuite bath with dual marble vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The second bedroom features a queen bed, custom cabinetry, a flat-screen TV, and its own ensuite bathroom with marble finishes and a tub/shower combination.Down the hall, a charming bunk room provides two built-in twin bunk beds, comfortably sleeping four. A nearby full bathroom with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed shower serves this space with ease.Loft Living & Rooftop ViewsA spiral staircase leads to one of Frosted Orange’s most unique features—a light-filled loft retreat surrounded by windows and cozy seating. This versatile space doubles as an additional sleeping area with twin beds and a flat-screen TV. Step outside onto the private balcony for an evening drink, or climb the ship’s ladder to the rooftop sun deck, where chaise loungers invite you to soak in panoramic views of Seaside’s rooftops and treetops. Sunset here is nothing short of spectacular.With its layered outdoor spaces, stylish interiors, and prime Seaside location, Frosted Orange delivers an unforgettable coastal escape designed for making lasting memories.* 5 night minimum in Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Sat to Sat 7 night minimum Summer. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. * Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $150 pet fee for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No pet over 40 lbs.FEATURES 1,812 square feet5-minute walk (352 yards) to beach access at Savannah Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AKeurig coffee makerWine fridge located in bar nookPrivate rear driveway with parking for two vehiclesConveniently located near adult and family poolsPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a permit)Fireplace is for decorative use onlyTankless water heaterPet-friendly for dogs up to 40 lbsSTR23-002148
